releaseNotes: Zuriel 2.10.10: clean light interface and readable Open Book card; restores light bottom navigation and expands book introductions correctly. Complete 66-book KJV remains available offline. Live online passage retrieval verified for AMP, TPT, NLT, NET, NIV, NASB and NKJV. GNT, Living Bible, ESV and CSB remain unavailable pending publisher/account access. Android signed upgrade smoke test passed in the emulator; This release supersedes the conflicting 2.10.9 release-tag attempt without replacing its existing APK.
